# SYNESIS_E068 — Error

## Description

Concept `concept_a` duplicated in a.syn and b.syn.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The concept `concept_a` is defined more than once in the
  project's organizing model:
  - a.syn
  - b.syn
  Each concept must have a unique name across the project. Check
  whether the two blocks represent the same concept — if so, merge them.
  If not, rename one of them so the names differ.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DuplicateOntologyConcept**: `concept_name`, `file_a`, `file_b`
